curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a hustler trades his son's hand in marriage to wipe his slate clean, will the young lovers be agreeable?
curatedMovie.description: To clear a debt with a fearsome gangster, a small-time hustler arranges for his teenage son to marry the crime boss's daughter, triggering immediate resistance from the young lovers caught in the middle.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A lively, multi-strand comedy of debts and courtship that keeps you engaged with its energetic tone.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Emir Kusturica crafts a lively romantic farce where underworld debts collide with stubborn youth, delivering a distinct blend of buoyant comedy and chaotic charm.
